name: Mobile Type 8 break-up
doc: Mobile Type 8's death (enemy attack 286, c0m105 with its two probes c0m106 / c0m107 in the next slots): the module draws the three with their pose entries that 3 bone scripts move, turn and break, sparks thrown off their marked bones' polygons, layouts and sprites at their bones, their colours blended to black, the screen flash and a white tile rising and fading, the sound and its voice, the music faded; no damage. Effect 298's and 290's kin. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag308_mobile_type8.cpp) run on the program's memory (its main's poses and sparks in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The main's ticks, the start sound and the voice (claimed at the start, released near the end), the screen flash, the three entities' colours blended to black, the battle files loaded at the end; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Bone scripts
parts.doc: The 3 bone scripts (one per entity: Mobile Type 8 and its two probes): each moves its entity's 45 pose entries (offsets, turns, their speeds, a bounce on the ground), throws sparks off bone groups, spawns layouts and sprites at bones, a full-screen quad, loops

parts.title: Bodies
parts.doc: The three entities drawn by the module with their pose entries (their shadow, then the bones not hidden)

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Sparks off the marked bones' polygons along their normals, drifting (two flipbooks)

parts.doc: The scripts' layouts at a bone, turned, scaled

parts.title: Sprites
parts.doc: The scripts' sprites at a bone (one, or a random burst), drifting, accelerating

parts.title: White tile
parts.doc: A full-screen tile rising, then fading
